constraint_results.judge_reason: While the implementation correctly fixes the unit comparison (measured_lag_ms > threshold_ms without dividing by 1000) and does call orgops.alerts.notify when lag exceeds threshold, it does NOT use the exact signature specified. The constraint requires orgops.alerts.notify('replication.lag.exceeded', lag_ms=measured_lag_ms), but the code uses alerts.notify('Replication lag exceeded threshold', measured_lag_ms=measured_lag_ms, threshold_ms=threshold_ms) with different message text and parameter names.
